texts.value: ATP-dependent chromatin-remodeling factor that specifically binds to the promoter of target genes, leading to chromatin remodeling, possibly by promoting deposition of histone H3.3. Involved in myogenesis via interaction with MYOD1: binds to myogenic gene regulatory sequences and mediates incorporation of histone H3.3 prior to the onset of myogenic gene expression, promoting their expression (By similarity)
Interacts with MYOD1. Interacts with histone H3.3 (By similarity)
The CHD1 helical C-terminal domain (CHCT) may bind DNA and nucleosomes

disease.description: A form of epileptic encephalopathy, a heterogeneous group of early-onset epilepsies characterized by refractory seizures, neurodevelopmental impairment, and poor prognosis. Development is normal prior to seizure onset, after which cognitive and motor delays become apparent. DEE94 is an autosomal dominant, severe form characterized by onset of multiple seizure types in the first few years of life.
